title: Applications
subtitle: Create or import an app, refine it in conversation, then preview and use it.
name: Name

home.title: Home
home.noResults: No matching applications. Try another name or tag.
home.noDescription: Add a description to make this app easier to find.

workspace.createHint: Describe your application on the left. The built-in app Agent develops in its own directory; details and run state appear here.
workspace.advanced: Advanced: install, preview, build and start
workspace.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas, e.g. Productivity, Life
workspace.previewHint: Load the app webpage when needed. It runs independently alongside the NomiFun conversation.
workspace.previewStopped: Preview or start the app before loading its webpage.
workspace.noWebpage: Web preview is not configured yet. Preview detects the current application files and starts it. You can also set the preview command and web address in Advanced settings.
workspace.sameOrigin: This address shares the NomiFun web origin. Open it in a separate window.
workspace.directoryHint: This application's sessions and run commands use its independent project directory. Original imported files remain in place.
workspace.stopToBindAgent: Stop the app before changing the Agent it calls.
workspace.createPlaceholder: Describe the NomiFun app you want to create…
workspace.importPlaceholder: Describe the source or artifact to import, or import manually on the right…
workspace.editPlaceholder: Describe a change or an issue to fix…
workspace.sessionMismatch: This development conversation does not match the current app. Return to Apps and reopen it.
workspace.createFailed: The creation result is unconfirmed. Check Apps before trying again to avoid a duplicate.
workspace.developing: Developing the application. Details, run settings and preview update from actual results.
workspace.configuring: Recognizing the generated application and filling in its run settings…
workspace.awaitingConfiguration: Run settings are not filled in yet. Continue with the built-in app Agent or enter them manually.
workspace.configured: Run settings are filled in. View or change them in advanced settings.
workspace.workspaceBusy: Development is running. Stop generation or wait for it to finish before importing, overwriting or deleting application files.

project.historyHint: This application's sessions use the same project files. Each keeps an independent conversation context.
project.empty: No project sessions yet. Describe what to build or change below.
project.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the session list. Your current session is retained; expand Project sessions to retry.

remoteAddress: This address is only reachable on the Host computer. Use the app on that computer, or configure an address reachable from this browser.

empty.title: Your applications live here
empty.hint: Create an app with the built-in app Agent, or import existing source and built programs.

import.title: Import application
import.hint: Files are copied to an application-owned folder. Your original files stay in place.
import.manualHint: Import directly using this form, or ask the built-in app Agent on the left to identify source or output and complete run settings.
import.hostPath: Folder or ZIP path on the Host
import.remoteHint: The path refers to the computer running NomiFun. You can also upload a ZIP from this browser.

overwrite.title: Replace current files
overwrite.hint: The app stops before its files are overwritten. Matching files are replaced and other files, including application data, remain. Rebuild and start after replacing files.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.hint: This stops the app and deletes its hosted source, output and local data. Ordinary development sessions and their history, original import files and external data are kept.

settings.title: Run settings
settings.hint: Commands run in the project directory. Optional commands can be left empty. Changes apply the next time the app starts.
settings.unsaved: Your edited fields are not saved yet. Other fields continue to follow the latest application settings.
settings.detectHint: Fill in recognizable run settings from the application files, keeping existing commands. This does not start the application.
settings.previewFallback: Not set separately; preview uses the production start command
settings.staticHint: Use the static preset only for ordinary webpage files. The Host fills in an available local port when you save. Server and background applications need their real foreground start command.
settings.environmentHint: One KEY=value per line. NomiFun connection values are supplied to running processes automatically.
settings.connectionHint: The app connects through its own backend. No NomiFun token or SDK is required.

tools.title: Application tools
tools.hint: Connect an app, then explicitly select its tools for this Agent. New apps are not enabled automatically.
